## Checklist

- [ ] `make lint` and `make test` pass
- [ ] Tests written from the acceptance criteria before the implementation, citing their requirement IDs
- [ ] Logic changed: the matching file in `docs/` updated (or no logic change; label the PR `docs-not-needed` and say why)
- [ ] Behavior changed: the feature-map spec and its platform status updated (or not a behavior change)
- [ ] New screen or changed layout: snapshots reviewed light and dark, accessibility baseline met
- [ ] Works on every platform, or the gap is listed in the feature map's platform differences
